sloka: स च पावक संकाशः कुमारः समपद्यत ।उत्थाय अग्निचयात् तस्मात् शरभंगो व्यरोचत ॥३-५-४१॥
transliteration: sa ca pāvaka saṁkāśaḥ kumāraḥ samapadyata ।utthāya agnicayāt tasmāt śarabhaṁgo vyarocata ॥3-5-41॥

translations.english: Sarabhanga then emerged youthful from that heap of fire, shining like a flame and looking very elegant৷৷
